description: React component for editing a brand, connected to Redux store, handling fetch, update, delete, and activation of brand data.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: React component for editing brand details, managing lifecycle events, and rendering the edit interface or not found message.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches brand data when component mounts based on URL parameter.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Refetches brand data if the URL parameter changes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the SubPage with EditBrand component if brand exists, otherwise NotFound.
